reading: The page is a festival site: a flex nav bar with three spaced items, a gradient angled hero shape behind the headline, three tilted scrolling marquee text bands ("NOISE...", hollow "MORE...", and a filled dark band "THREE DAYS..."), a spinning badge circle reading "TICKETS ON SALE...", a paragraph of hero copy, and a white pill CTA button with a hard offset shadow. Page-wide styling is yellow background, Helvetica type, near-black text.
